text.tspan: Price paid for the same clear request: names associated with Black vs White buyers (H1) and women vs men
(H2). Blue ticks: detectable gap after Holm at m = 8 (Haiku + Luna); none pre-registered for GPT-6 Luna.
Tests: Holm correction across 8 tests.

rect.style: stroke-width: 1px; stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke-opacity: 0; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 0;

text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; fill: rgb(31, 31, 28); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;

tspan.tspan: H1, names associated with Black vs White buyers:

text.tspan: Claude Haiku 5.5: no evidence of a gap, inside the 3% equivalence margin (estimate -0.1%, 95% CI -1.4% to +1.2%)
GPT-6 Luna: names associated with Black buyers paid 1.8% less (95% CI -2.6% to -0.9%), significant after Holm

rect.style: stroke-width: 1px; stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke-opacity: 0; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 0;

text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; fill: rgb(107, 106, 99); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Every gap is focal group minus comparison group: a negative gap means the focal group paid less.
A gap counts only if its Holm-adjusted p < 0.05; the bar is the unadjusted 95% interval. Blue ticks: a true gap this size is flagged at least
80% of the time (fixed before the main run).
The Claude Haiku 5.5 pilot put the spread between names at 0 (for both H1 and H2), so the detectable gap may be optimistic.
Dotted lines: equivalence margins (symmetric on log price: +3.0% pairs with -2.9%).
Dollar columns translate the percent gap at the comparison group's average price paid (per $1M uses the percent only). Not separate tests.
